component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.menu = m.top.findNode("menu") m.stack = m.top.findNode("stack") m.global.addFields({ focusInInit: false }) end sub
function runScenarios(_params as object) as object print "=== Detached Init Focus Repro ===" runScenario("1 (keyboard focused in init)", true) runScenario("2 (keyboard focused by the opener)", false) print "=== Detached Init Focus Repro Complete ===" return invalid end function
sub runScenario(label as string, inInit as boolean) print "-- scenario " + label m.stack.removeChildrenIndex(m.stack.getChildCount(), 0) m.menu.setFocus(true) m.global.focusInInit = inInit view = CreateObject("roSGNode", "SearchView") view.id = "search" if not inInit then view.keyboard.setFocus(true) print " before push: menu=" + m.menu.hasFocus().toStr() + " keyboard=" + view.keyboard.hasFocus().toStr() m.stack.appendChild(view) view.setFocus(true) print " after push: screen=" + view.hasFocus().toStr() + " keyboard=" + view.keyboard.hasFocus().toStr() + " menu=" + m.menu.hasFocus().toStr() + " chain=" + chain() end sub
function chain() as string s = "" node = m.top while node.focusedChild <> invalid and not node.focusedChild.isSameNode(node) node = node.focusedChild s = s + "/" + node.id end while return s end function
